The facility has an underdeveloped contingency plan that does not clearly identify a chain of command, identify specific
events that would trigger the plan or specific tasks to be carried out in response, nor has annual review been
documented. Failure to develop a complete contingency plan may result in poor response to emergencies that can
negatively affect animal welfare. Each dealer must develop, document and follow an appropriate contingency plan that
includes elements listed in this subpart.
To be corrected by 03 September 2026.

Two separate kennels for two adult male dogs "Champ" (microchip: 990000006746719) & "Eaton" (microchip:
992000001724672) have worn paint resulting in excessive rust of the underlying metal. Exposure to rust may cause
illness in animals or prevent adequate cleaning of surfaces. Interior surfaces that come in contact with dogs must be free
of excessive rust that prevents the required cleaning and sanitization.
To be corrected by 03 September 2026.

A puppy is missing vaccines on a schedule approved by the attending veterinarian. A 15-week old female puppy "Emily"
(microchip: 992000006066068) has not received an initial bordetella or leptospirosis vaccine scheduled to be given at 8
weeks and 12 weeks respectively. Failure to follow the vaccine schedule approved by the attending veterinarian may
result in preventable illness of the animal. Dealers must follow an appropriate program of veterinary care approved by the
attending veterinarian to include the vaccination schedule for contagious diseases of dogs. Correct by scheduling the
approved vaccines to be given.
To be corrected by 03 September 2026.
This is a 1st Re-License Inspection for a Class “A” license. The inspection and exit briefing were conducted with the
applicant.
All items must be in compliance within 2 more inspection(s) or by 01 November 2026 or the applicant will forfeit the
license fee and must wait 6 months to reapply. Please contact your inspector to schedule your next Re-License
Inspection.
Regulated activity can continue under your existing USDA license until it expires.
